name: DeleteRuleAction

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the rule action to delete.

This is the rule action ID returned after you call [CreateRuleAction](~~69586~~) to create a rule action. You can also call [ListRuleActions](~~69517~~) to view the rule action ID in the response.
parameters.description_zh:
要删除的规则动作ID。

调用[CreateRuleAction](~~69586~~)创建规则动作成功后，返回的规则动作ID，您也可以调用[ListRuleActions](~~69517~~)，从返回结果中查看对应的规则动作ID。
